adaptations.reason: Socket bind and network send are prohibited in this execution environment. Use an inherited private IPC descriptor with read/write to the isolated test pool. Stratum JSON messages stay unchanged. This does not test TCP.
Interpret work filter byte as signed base-two difficulty exponent in the declared low-rate protocol variant. Original minimum difficulty one would require ~2^32 hashes per result.
Recompute each nonce and compare to the programmed device target for the low-rate source variant. The unchanged submission path applies the separate pool target.
Retry temporary PTY backpressure with a bounded 1 second readiness wait, without discarding a partial packet.
After a clean job, permit one replacement work packet to clear a full low-rate queue. Without this change, the original driver waits for a full nonce range to finish.
Key consecutive duplicate detection by work ID plus nonce. This permits nonce zero on the first job and equal nonces in different jobs, while preserving same-work duplicate rejection.

UBSAN found an original unaligned uint64_t store in Stratum nonce2 serialization. Use memcpy with the same eight bytes. Align the temporary device target. Include work identity in the low-rate pool duplicate check, including an explicit first-result flag.
UBSAN found a second original unaligned load in show_hash when the first nonzero display byte has arbitrary offset. memcpy preserves the displayed four bytes.

A low-rate early result can carry queue credits from before later writes, while the original receive thread waits for the send mutex. Do not restore spent credits from nonce responses; status polling still reports full queue state. This prevents real queue overflow without changing model readback.

Bound hash-prefix reads to the final valid four-byte window. Track pending clean replacement independently of queue reports. Associate at most one outstanding status request with sent-work count and clean generation; deduct later writes and ignore older generations. Exact helpers have bounded C regression cases under UBSAN.

build_environment.isolation: Private user, network, mount and PID namespaces; read-only installed /usr toolchain; private bounded /work and /tmp; original source archive read-only; runtime uses only locked file inputs.

capabilities.functional_mining: Requires separately retained per-run firmware, device and independent pool evidence. This input manifest does not declare a passing result.
